# Camp Resource: Slime Cake

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jan 19, 2025
- 2 min read

Updated: Mar 23, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_851bc259f01847b098140a2f51333b28~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

Whatever that is, it ain't frosting...

- Collects a Slice of Slime Cake over time -

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Slime Cake__

Image Credit: SugarBombsRADS/Nerevar/vc59755/Reasonable Madness

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e41098662684408ba710dec2b9f17ccc~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_04d8f6dca3014bbbbeb5f616eef97520~mv2.jpg)

**Produces**

Produces Slime Cake over time

**Buffs**

- Radiation Damage 
 - +30 Radiation per slice.
- Charisma 
 - +3 Charisma for 90 minutes
- AP Refill (restores Action Points) 
 - 12 AP points for 25 Seconds
- Restores Hunger 
 - 1440 points
- Restores Health 
 - 3.6% HP for 25 seconds

**Keywords**

Food

Gourmet

Pastry

Cooked Meal

Can Not Be Sold to Vendors

Cakes and Pies

Bread

Birthday Cake

**Spoil Rate**

Turns into Spoiled Fruit

Base Spoil Rate: 6.5 Hours

30% Reduced Spoil Rate: 8.5 Hours

50% Reduced Spoil Rate: 9.8 Hours

60% Reduced Spoil Rate: 10.4 Hours

90% Reduced Spoil Rate: 12.4 Hours

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

Birthday Cake

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Materials required to craft resource**

2x Nuclear Material

2x Sugar

2x Spices

2x Razorgrain Flour

**Holds**

2 Pounds (8 Slices)

**Obtainable via**

Season 20 - Glow of the Ghoul - Page 4 - 55 Tickets

Gold Bullion - X - Cautious - X Bullion

**Produces X amount per**

10 minutes and 12 seconds

**Cake lasts X minutes in the collector**

135 minutes

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

2 Flamingo Units
